name: vid.embodied/feasibility/star
source: STAR, prediction and feasibility questions, validation split (Wu et al., 2021)
notes: 362 Charades videos, 500 questions; for prediction questions the video ends at the question's cutoff.

name: vid.embodied/procedure/captaincook4d
source: CaptainCook4D, step error annotations (Peddi et al., 2024)
criteria_source: Adapted from CaptainCook4D's step-level error annotations
notes: 96 recordings, 500 steps (250 with an error, 250 without); the recipe step is quoted. Every item shows the complete recording with the step's annotated interval given in the text (recordings median 793 s, steps median 34 s), so the surrounding steps are visible for order and omission errors. Gold is CaptainCook4D's error annotation; some error kinds (such as quantities) are hard to see.

name: vid.embodied/robot_success/robofac
criteria_source: Adapted from RoboFAC's trajectory success labels; the task text is RoboFAC's
notes: 500 trajectories across RoboFAC's environments (250 successes, 250 failures); the window is the whole trajectory, so the outcome is visible at its end.
